NSC Delhi Science Communicator Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for NSC Delhi Science Communicator Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Science Communicator post is scheduled for 01 September 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Science Communicators post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a fresh regular M.Sc. Degree in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, or Biology (Zoology/Botany) obtained on or after 2023 from a recognized University.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Science Communicator post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Science Communicator post announced by the National Science Centre.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Science Communicator position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 35,000 per month for the contractual period.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Science Communicator role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Walk-in-Test, which includes an Aptitude & Communication Skill Test.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, ID proof, and any other relevant documents as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Candidates need to appear directly for the interview at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the National Science Centre located?
faq.answer: The National Science Centre is located in New Delhi, with the pincode 110001.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contractual job. The recruitment is for contractual Science Communicator.
